headline: GM-GReFEL: Geometry-Guided Spatiotemporal State-Space Learning for Robust D
summary: Recognizing facial expressions in unconstrained video suffers from two coupled problems: self-attention grows quadratically in cost with clip length, and crowdsourced labels are noisy.
